snippet.title: Mario Kart World Direct 4.17.2025
snippet.description:
Join us on April 17 at 6 a.m. PT to learn more about Mario Kart World for Nintendo Switch 2 in the Mario Kart World Direct. The livestream will be roughly 15 minutes. Pre-order Mario Kart World today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/gaming-systems/switch-2/featured-games/mario-kart-world/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
